page.layout: One page of a table in four or more columns, with a header of two lines above; the columns read left to right: Ordinal Julian number, Olympiad, Anno urbis conditae, dominical letters, Nabonassar year with the ferial-day marks in dashes, and feria number at the far right. No marginal notes; the page number 483 is printed at the lower right.

main_text.l: Anni ante Aur. | Anni Olym- | An.Vrb. | Literæ | Nabona- | Feriæ.

page.notes: Reference marks d, e and f stand in the Nabonassar column at 184, 189 and 219; their footnotes are not printed on this page. The dashed rules in the last two columns are ferial marks drawn as lines, transcribed as dashes; the Ian. entries are the January day marks. The number 27 and 26 stand in the Olympiad column beside the first line of each Olympiad. The page number 483 is printed at the lower right and is not a running head. Several figures in the Nabonassar and Feriae columns are small and may be misread.
